stem:
The probability density function, f, of a random variable $X$ is given by

$$\text{f}(x) = \begin{cases} k(1 + \cos x) & 0 \leqslant x \leqslant \pi, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise,} \end{cases}$$

where $k$ is a constant.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Verify that the median of $X$ lies between 0.83 and 0.84.
